name: The Ritz-Carlton, Sarasota
positioning: Downtown Sarasota resort (officially The Ritz-Carlton, Sarasota) with guest access to a Beach Club on Lido Key and a Tom Fazio golf course
best_for: Travelers who want a downtown base with guest access to a Gulf beach club
Golfers who want access to a Tom Fazio-designed course

facts.text: Resort guests have access to The Ritz-Carlton Beach Club, three miles away on the white sands of Lido Key.
A complimentary shuttle runs hourly between the resort and the Beach Club, starting daily at 9 a.m.
The Beach Club has a zero-entry outdoor pool that is heated year-round.
Jack Dusty is a waterfront seafood restaurant with local ingredients, craft microbrews and cocktails, and downtown marina views.
Rufa serves cocktails and shareables with sunset views of Sarasota Bay.
The Lido Key Tiki Bar is an open-air tiki hut next to the Beach Club and a Lido Beach public access point.
Jack Dusty received a 2025 OpenTable Diners' Choice Award.
Guest rooms and suites have private balconies and marble-trimmed bathrooms.
The Ritz-Carlton Suite has expansive windows and private balconies with panoramic views of the Bay and marina.
The spa's wellness facilities include a jacuzzi, steam and dry saunas, and a waterfront relaxation terrace.
The Ritz-Carlton Golf Club course was designed by Tom Fazio and is 13 miles from the resort, at Lakewood Ranch.

highlights.text: Ridley's Porch, the Beach Club restaurant, is named for the rare Kemp's ridley sea turtles that frequent the shore.
The Ritz-Carlton Golf Club course was designed by Tom Fazio.
Resort guests have access to the Beach Club on the white sands of Lido Key.
The spa's signature treatment combines a full-body massage, exfoliation and a mineral-rich seaweed soak.

considerations.text: The resort is in downtown Sarasota, and the Beach Club is a separate site three miles away.
The golf course is 13 miles from the resort, at Lakewood Ranch, and is open only to resort guests and members.
Club Level access is a paid premium and is not included in general room bookings.
